scenes.heading: Who is doing what?
scenes.label: FIX THE FOLLOW-UP
scenes.narration: Your meeting ended. But who is doing what? Turn messy notes into a clear action list.

scenes.heading: Give AI one clear job
scenes.label: USE A SAFE COPY
scenes.narration: First, remove private and confidential details. Then ask AI: list each action, its owner, and its deadline.

scenes.heading: Never let AI guess
scenes.label: MISSING DOES NOT MEAN GUESS
scenes.narration: Missing a name or date? Tell AI to write not specified. Never let it guess.

scenes.heading: Check before sharing
scenes.label: A TASK NEEDS THREE THINGS
scenes.narration: Now check every task against your notes. Confirm the owners and dates with your team.

scenes.heading: Turn notes into action
scenes.label: START WITH ONE MEETING
scenes.narration: You now have actions you can actually follow. Try one meeting, and save this prompt for next time.
